questions.stem: Which of these numbers has the digit $5$ in the ten-thousands place?
questions.explanation: In $54,\!321$ the digit $5$ occupies the ten-thousands position ($5 \times 10,\!000 = 50,\!000$). In $45,\!321$ the $5$ is in the thousands place. In $503,\!210$ the $5$ is in the hundred-thousands place.
